about.text: Japanese milks whose fat or solids are changed. Low-fat milk has 0.5 to 1.5% fat and non-fat milk under 0.5%, with the fat separated off; component-adjusted milk has some components removed or concentrated, with at least 8% non-fat solids. The categories date from 2002.

sources.text: The definitions and the 2002 renames, from this article.
